company_info.description: Sawafuji Electric Co.,Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of electrical equipment, generators, and refrigerators in Japan and internationally. The company offers starters, alternators, HV and DC motors, battery packs, and control devices. It also provides portable refrigerators under the ENGEL brand; gasoline and diesel engine generators under the Elemax brand; and engine welders and retarder. In addition, the company is involved in the provision of transportation and freightage services; and production and sale of coolers and ice boxes, and generators under the ENGEL brand. The company was formerly known as Sawafuji Electric Manufactory and changed its name to Sawafuji Electric Co.,Ltd. in 1934. Sawafuji Electric Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1908 and is headquartered in Ota, Japan.
